description: Home screen full rewrite + Services menu + More screen. Depends on FEAT-001 (all widgets and models must exist). Rewrites lib/screens/home/home_screen.dart with all 11 sections; creates services_menu_screen.dart and more_screen.dart; updates router.dart to add /services and /more inside the ShellRoute.
steps:
1. Fully rewrite `lib/screens/home/home_screen.dart`. The screen is a CustomScrollView with a SliverAppBar (expandedHeight:220, pinned:true, backgroundColor:AppTheme.primaryColor) and one SliverToBoxAdapter containing all sections as a Column. Structure:

   HERO SliverAppBar flexibleSpace:
   - Container with LinearGradient [AppTheme.primaryColor, Color(0xFF004D38)]
   - SafeArea > Padding(16,12,16,0) > Column:
     - Row: Icon(location_on, white70, 16) + Text('টাঙ্গাইল জেলা', white70, 12)
     - SizedBox(4)
     - Row: Expanded(Text('আমাদের টাঙ্গাইল', white, 22, bold)) + Text('২৯° ☁️', white, 16) [weather stub]
     - Text('আপনার জেলার সকল দরকারি তথ্য একটি ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মে', white70, 13)
     - SizedBox(8)
     - Row of 2 CTA buttons (spacing:8):
       * ElevatedButton 'সেবা খুঁজুন' white bg, primaryColor text → context.go('/services')
       * ElevatedButton.icon(Icons.phone, '৯৯৯') red bg → FlutterPhoneDirectCaller.callNumber('999')
     - SizedBox(8)
     - PrayerTimesStrip() widget

   SliverToBoxAdapter Column children:
   - Padding(h:16,v:12) SearchBarWidget()
   - SectionHeader('দ্রুত সেবা')
   - Quick pills: SizedBox(height:48) horizontal ListView.builder of 6 pills from AppConstants.quickServicePills, each a GestureDetector > Container(rounded:20, color:pill.color.withOpacity(0.1), padding:h12v8) > Row[Text(pill.emoji,16)+SizedBox(4)+Text(pill.label,12,w600,pill.color)]
   - SectionHeader('সকল সেবা', actionLabel:'সব দেখুন', onAction:→/services)
   - GridView.count(crossAxisCount:2, shrinkWrap:true, physics:NeverScroll, childAspectRatio:1.4) of AppConstants.serviceCategories — each ServiceCategoryCard(icon,label,route,color)
   - SectionHeader('উপজেলা সমূহ')
   - UpazilaGridWidget()
   - SectionHeader('রক্তের গ্রুপ খুঁজুন')
   - Container(margin:h16, padding:16, gradient:LinearGradient([secondaryColor, Color(0xFFB91C1C)]), rounded:16) > Column[Text headline white + SizedBox(12) + BloodGroupSelector(onSelected:(bg)=>context.push('/blood-donors?group=bg'))]
   - SectionHeader('সর্বশেষ নোটিশ', actionLabel:'সব দেখুন', onAction:→/news)
   - _NoticesPreview() — StreamBuilder on NewsService().getNotices(limit:3), renders 3 NoticeCard items (compact row: warning icon, title, date)
   - SectionHeader('বিশিষ্ট ব্যক্তিবর্গ', actionLabel:'সব দেখুন', onAction:→/notable-persons)
   - _NotablePersonsPreview() — StreamBuilder on Firestore notable_persons orderBy('name') limit(3), renders 3 compact cards (circle photo + name + designation)
   - SectionHeader('পর্যটন স্থান', actionLabel:'সব দেখুন', onAction:→/tourism)
   - _TourismPreview() — StreamBuilder on Firestore tourism orderBy('name') limit(3), renders 3 horizontal image cards (CachedNetworkImage, name, category badge)
   - SectionHeader('ফটো গ্যালারি', actionLabel:'সব দেখুন', onAction:→/gallery)
   - _GalleryPreview() — StreamBuilder on Firestore gallery orderBy('createdAt',desc) limit(6), renders SizedBox(120) horizontal ListView of 6 square CachedNetworkImage thumbnails
   - Container(margin:all(16), padding:16, color:AppTheme.accentColor, rounded:16) blue CTA: Column[Text('আপনার জেলায় ব্যবসা বা সেবা আছে?', white, 16, bold), SizedBox(6), Text('আজই যোগ করুন এবং আরও বেশি মানুষের কাছে পৌঁছান', white70, 12)]
   - SizedBox(80) bottom padding

2. Create `lib/screens/services/services_menu_screen.dart`: Scaffold(appBar:AppBar(title:'সকল সেবা')). Body: GridView.count(crossAxisCount:2, padding:16, crossAxisSpacing:12, mainAxisSpacing:12, childAspectRatio:1.0) of all AppConstants.serviceCategories. Each ServiceMenuCard: white Container, rounded:12, boxShadow, Column[Container(circle, color.withOpacity(0.12), Icon(color,32)), SizedBox(8), Text(label, 13, w600, center)]. Tapping → context.push(route).

3. Create `lib/screens/more/more_screen.dart`: Scaffold(appBar:AppBar(title:'আরও')). Body: ListView of ListTile rows:
   - জরুরি নম্বর (Icons.emergency_rounded, red) → context.push('/emergency')
   - রক্তদাতা (Icons.water_drop_rounded, red) → context.push('/blood-donors')
   - অ্যাম্বুলেন্স (Icons.airport_shuttle_rounded, orange) → context.push('/ambulance')
   - নামাজের সময় (Icons.access_time_rounded, green) → show bottom sheet with PrayerTimesStrip expanded
   - শেয়ার করুন (Icons.share_rounded, blue) → Share.share('আমাদের টাঙ্গাইল অ্যাপ ডাউনলোড করুন')
   - আমাদের সম্পর্কে (Icons.info_rounded, grey) → show dialog with app info
   Each ListTile: leading Container(circle icon), title, trailing Icon(chevron_right).

4. Update `lib/config/router.dart`: add imports for ServicesMenuScreen and MoreScreen. Inside ShellRoute.routes add GoRoute(path:'/services') and GoRoute(path:'/more'). Run flutter analyze to confirm no import errors.
